enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn onto the left side. Place the phone on the bedside stand. Reach out and press the desk lamp switch to turn it off. Close the eyes. Roll onto the back. Pull the blanket higher. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Breathe slowly. Stay still under the blanket. Shift the legs under the sheet. Turn onto the left side again. Keep the eyes closed through the remaining hours. Remain lying in bed until the alarm rings at 08:00.

Open the eyes. Reach to the phone on the stand and press the alarm off. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bedroom door, open it, step into the hallway and close it behind. Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Step in. Turn on the tap and adjust the water temperature with the handle. Take off the clothes and hang them on the hook. Step into the shower. Wet the hair under the water. Pick up the shampoo bottle and squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub it into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the body wash and apply it with the hand. Rinse the body. Turn off the tap. Grab the towel from the rail. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the face, arms, chest, legs and feet. Wrap the towel around the waist. Wipe the mirror with the hand. Pick up the toothbrush and rinse it under the tap. Turn off the tap. Turn off the light. Open the door and walk out with the towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, toasting bread and eating breakfast, overlapping briefly with Member 3's breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the bathroom to Bedroom 4. Put on clean clothes. Walk to the kitchen. Say to Member 3: 'Morning, kettle is free.' Pick up the kettle from the counter. Open the tap and fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle back on its base. Press the kettle switch down. Open the upper cupboard and take out a mug. Put a tea bag into the mug. Open the bread bag on the counter. Take out two slices of bread. Place the slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the butter and milk. Place them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Wait beside the counter. Take the plate from the cupboard. When the toaster pops, lift the slices onto the plate. Pick up the butter knife, spread butter on both slices. Pour the boiled water from the kettle into the mug. Add milk. Pick up the spoon and stir the tea. Place the plate and mug on the table. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Pick up a slice of bread and eat it. Lift the mug and drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying Commerce and IT course readings on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 4. Pull the chair out from the desk. Sit down. Press the computer power button. Press the desk lamp switch on. Wait for the screen to load. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the browser. Open the university learning portal. Click the Commerce course folder. Open the PDF reading. Scroll down the pages with the mouse wheel. Highlight a paragraph with the cursor. Open a new document on the second half of the screen. Type notes on the keyboard. Switch to the IT lecture slides. Scroll through the slides. Open the lecture recording tab. Click play. Pause the video. Type more notes into the document. Save the document with Ctrl+S. Click into the discussion forum and type a reply. Post the reply. Close the browser tab.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping for the week; meets Member 3 at the local shops from 11:00 and returns together
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Pick up the tote bags from the shelf. Walk to the front door. Put on shoes. Open the front door and step out. Close the door. Walk down the path and along the street towards the local shops. Reach the shop entrance. Pick up a shopping basket. Walk through the aisles. Take vegetables and place them in the basket. Pick up a bag of rice and put it in the basket. Check the price tag on the shelf. Walk to the milk section and take a carton. Meet Member 3 at the aisle at 11:00 and say: 'I have the rice and veg, did you get the eggs?' Walk together to the checkout. Place the items on the counter belt. Pay with the bank card at the terminal. Tap the card. Pick up the bags. Walk back home with Member 3 carrying the bags in both hands. Reach the front door. Open it and step inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and prepping lunch ingredients with Member 3
enriched_activities.desc: Place the grocery bags on the kitchen counter. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk, vegetables and eggs from the bags. Place the milk carton on the fridge shelf. Put the vegetables into the crisper drawer. Close the refrigerator door. Put the rice bag into the lower cupboard. Open the freezer door and place the frozen items inside. Close the freezer door. Fold the empty tote bags and put them on the shelf. Say to Member 3: 'I will cut the vegetables.' Take the chopping board from the rack. Place it on the counter. Pick up the knife from the drawer. Take the vegetables from the fridge. Rinse the vegetables under the tap. Place them on the board. Cut the vegetables into pieces with the knife. Push the cut pieces into a bowl with the hand.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch, sharing the kitchen with Member 3 and Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Press the range hood switch on. Press the induction cooker power button. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the chopped vegetables into the pan with the hand. Pick up the spatula and stir the vegetables. Add salt from the container. Stir again. Turn the heat knob down. Open the cupboard and take out three bowls. Place the bowls on the counter. Spoon the food from the pan into the bowls. Carry the bowl to the table. Pull the chair out and sit down. Pick up the chopsticks and eat the rice and vegetables. Say to Member 2: 'There is extra in the pan if you want some.' Lift the bowl and finish the rice. Stand up. Carry the bowl and chopsticks to the sink. Rinse the bowl under the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Running an online tutoring session for students
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 4. Pull the chair out. Sit down at the desk. Wake up the computer screen. Open the video meeting application. Click the meeting link. Put the headset on the ears and adjust the microphone. Click the share screen button. Open the worksheet document. Say: 'Good afternoon, let us start with question one.' Point at the screen with the pen. Type the equation on the shared whiteboard. Ask the student a question and listen through the headset. Click the annotation tool and circle a number on the screen. Open the textbook PDF and scroll to the exercise page. Write the steps in the chat box and press enter. Mute the microphone. Unmute the microphone. Answer a question. Click the next slide arrow. Say: 'That is all for today, see you on Thursday.' Click the leave meeting button. Take the headset off and place it on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk chair. Walk out of Bedroom 4 to the living room. Sit down on the couch. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button on the remote. Press the channel buttons to choose a program. Place the remote on the couch cushion. Pick up the game console controller from the table. Press the controller power button. Wait for the console menu on the screen. Use the arrow buttons to select a game. Press the confirm button. Play the game, pressing the buttons with both thumbs. Lean forward during the round. Pause the game with the start button. Stand up and stretch the arms. Sit down again. Continue playing. Press the pause button again. Place the controller on the table. Pick up the remote and switch back to the TV channel.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing freelance analyst work on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the couch. Walk to Bedroom 4. Pull the chair out and sit down. Press the computer spacebar to wake the screen. Open the spreadsheet application. Load the client data file. Click a cell and type the numbers on the keyboard. Drag the fill handle down the column with the mouse. Click the formula bar and type a formula. Press enter. Click the chart button and insert a bar chart. Adjust the chart size with the mouse. Open the email client. Click the attach file button. Select the spreadsheet file and click open. Type the email subject line and body text. Click send. Open the browser and log into the client dashboard. Download the new data file. Save it to the folder.

Stand up from the chair. Pick up the water bottle from the desk. Walk to the front door. Put on the running shoes and tie the laces. Open the front door and step out. Close the door behind. Walk down the path to the street. Walk at a steady pace along the pavement. Turn right at the corner. Increase the pace to a light jog for a block. Slow back to a walk. Stop at the park and place the bottle on the bench. Stretch the arms over the head. Bend forward and stretch the legs. Straighten up. Pick up the bottle and drink water. Walk back along the same street. Reach the front door. Open it and step inside. Take off the shoes and place them on the rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Running the washing machine and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom carrying the laundry basket. Open the washing machine door. Put the clothes into the drum. Pick up the detergent bottle and pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Close the washing machine door. Press the program button and set the cycle. Press the start button. Straighten up. Take off the clothes and place them in the basket. Turn on the tap and adjust the temperature. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Apply shampoo and rinse. Apply body wash and rinse. Turn off the tap. Grab the towel and dry the body and hair. Wrap the towel around the waist. Wipe the wet floor with the mop. Open the door and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner and eating it together with Member 1, Member 2 and Member 3
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Say to Member 1: 'I will do the rice.' Take the rice cooker pot from the shelf. Measure rice with the cup and pour it into the pot. Rinse the rice under the tap. Add water to the line. Place the pot into the rice cooker. Close the lid and press the cook switch. Open the refrigerator and take out the vegetables and meat. Place them on the chopping board. Cut the meat into strips with the knife. Press the induction cooker power on. Place the frying pan on the cooker. Pour oil and add the meat. Pick up the spatula and stir. Add the vegetables and stir again. Add sauce from the bottle. Turn off the induction cooker. Carry the dishes to the table. Pull the chair out and sit down. Eat the rice and dishes with the chopsticks. Talk with the other members about the day. Stand up and carry the plate to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with TV and game console with Member 1, Member 2 and Member 3
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to the living room. Sit down on the couch beside Member 2. Pick up the TV remote and press the power button. Press the channel button to pick a program. Place the remote on the table. Pick up the game console controller. Press the power button. Choose a two-player game from the menu with the arrow buttons. Hand the second controller to Member 1. Press the buttons to start the round. Play the game, moving the character with the joystick. Lean back on the couch between rounds. Say to Member 3: 'Your turn next.' Hand the controller over. Pick up the phone and check messages. Put the phone back into the pocket. Pick up the controller again. Continue the game. Press the pause button when the show resumes on TV. Place the controller on the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing lecture notes and planning the study week
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the couch. Walk to Bedroom 4. Pull the chair out and sit down at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch on. Open the notebook on the desk. Turn the pages back to the lecture notes. Read the notes and follow the lines with the pen. Pick up the pen and underline a heading. Open the computer and click the course calendar page. Check the assignment deadlines. Open the weekly planner on the desk. Write the task list for Monday to Friday in the planner. Draw a box beside each item. Open the phone and check the group chat messages. Type a reply and send it. Close the notebook and place the pen in the holder. Press the desk lamp switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom carrying the toiletry pouch. Push the door open and turn on the light. Place the pouch on the sink edge. Open the zip. Take out the toothbrush and toothpaste. Turn on the tap and wet the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Turn off the tap. Brush the teeth up and down. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Rinse the toothbrush under the tap. Put the toothbrush and toothpaste back into the pouch. Turn on the tap and wash the face with the hands. Pat the face dry with the towel. Wipe the sink edge with the towel. Turn off the light. Open the door and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down on the phone and falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 4. Close the bedroom door. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the legs. Pick up the phone from the bedside stand. Unlock the screen with the thumb. Scroll through the video feed. Tap a video and watch it. Swipe up to the next video. Open the messaging app and read the messages. Type a short reply and send it. Put the phone down on the stand. Reach for the charging cable and plug it into the phone. Turn on the desk lamp? No. Press the desk lamp switch to turn the light off. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Close the eyes and lie still.
